limitations: Scanned historical reproductions have limited tonal fidelity and some paper noise; no cleanup was applied.
Earlier civic seals/emblems are labelled as such rather than incorrectly equated with formal grants.
The1988 Port Moody drawing is an artistic specimen of the same granted arms, not a superseded heraldic design.
Source diagram captions are evidence; the registration records provide modern holder association, not a claim that older seals were part of those grants.
